Scarlet & Violet series · TEF

Temporal Forces

Released March 22, 2024 · 218 cards

StandardExpanded

Temporal Forces is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on March 22, 2024. Its main set has 162 cards, plus 56 secret rares numbered beyond the set (218 in total). It includes 185 Pokémon, 31 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
